import SwiftUI
import Combine

#if canImport(UIKit)
import UIKit
typealias PlatformColor = UIColor
#else
import AppKit
typealias PlatformColor = NSColor
#endif

public protocol Repository {
    associatedtype Item: Identifiable & Sendable
    func load() async throws -> [Item]
    func save(_ item: Item) async throws
    var count: Int { get }
}

struct Task: Identifiable, Hashable, Sendable {
    let id: UUID
    var title: String
    var isDone: Bool = false
    enum Priority: Int, CaseIterable { case low = 0, medium, high
        case urgent }
    var priority: Priority = .low
}

@MainActor
final class TaskStore: ObservableObject {
    @Published private(set) var tasks: [Task] = []
    @Published var filter: String = ""
    private var cancellables = Set<AnyCancellable>()
    private let repository: any Repository

    init(repository: any Repository) {
        self.repository = repository
        $filter
            .debounce(for: .milliseconds(200), scheduler: DispatchQueue.main)
            .sink { [weak self] _ in self?.objectWillChange.send() }
            .store(in: &cancellables)
    }

    var visible: [Task] {
        guard !filter.isEmpty else { return tasks }
        return tasks.filter { $0.title.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(filter) }
    }

    func reload() async {
        do {
            let items = try await repository.load()
            tasks = items.compactMap { $0 as? Task }
        } catch {
            print("failed: \(error)")
        }
    }

    func toggle(_ task: Task) {
        guard let index = tasks.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == task.id }) else { return }
        tasks[index].isDone.toggle()
    }

    subscript(id: UUID) -> Task? {
        get { tasks.first { $0.id == id } }
        set {
            if let newValue, let i = tasks.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == id }) {
                tasks[i] = newValue
            }
        }
    }
}

struct Box<Value: Equatable>: Equatable where Value: Sendable {
    var value: Value
    static func == (lhs: Box, rhs: Box) -> Bool { lhs.value == rhs.value }
    func map<T: Equatable & Sendable>(_ transform: (Value) -> T) -> Box<T> {
        Box<T>(value: transform(value))
    }
}

actor Counter {
    private var value = 0
    func increment() -> Int { value += 1; return value }
}

extension Array where Element == Task {
    func done() -> [Task] { filter(\.isDone) }
}

private extension TaskStore {
    func resetForTesting() { tasks = [] }
}

struct Row0View: View {
    @ObservedObject var store: TaskStore
    @State private var expanded = false
    @Environment(\.colorScheme) private var scheme
    var task: Task

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            Image(systemName: task.isDone ? "checkmark.circle.fill" : "circle")
                .foregroundStyle(scheme == .dark ? Color.white : Color.black)
            VStack(alignment: .leading) {
                Text(task.title).font(.headline)
                if expanded {
                    Text("Priority \(task.priority.rawValue)")
                }
            }
            Spacer()
            Button("Toggle") { store.toggle(task) }
        }
        .onTapGesture { withAnimation { expanded.toggle() } }
        .task { await store.reload() }
        #if DEBUG
        .border(Color.red)
        #endif
    }

    private func helper0(_ a: Int, label b: String) -> some View {
        Text("\(a)\(b)")
    }
}
